metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace that ships the `outlook` agent plugin (Claude Code, Cowork, Copilot, Cursor, and other plugin-compatible agents) — full Microsoft Outlook (classic desktop) integration: mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, categories, rules, OOO.

plugins.name: outlook
